title: TWRP C3B2 Master Document List Dashboard — Knowledge Base
description: Machine-readable blueprint of the MDL dashboard: a standalone offline HTML file that reads the Master Document List workbook through the Code sheet contract and renders the register, validation and Issue Progress views.

project_metadata.name: TWRP C3B2 — Master Document List Interactive Dashboard
project_metadata.description: Single-file, offline dashboard generated from ES modules in src/ and shared source in common/.
project_metadata.purpose: Show the active document register, submission and approval status, overdue work, validation findings and Issue Progress from one Master Document List workbook.

architecture_overview.status: Modular pipeline with a configuration-driven welcome page. build.mjs inlines xlsx-reader.mjs, pipeline.mjs, render.mjs and CommonWelcome 1.4.1 into MDL-Dashboard.html. No delivered file references common/. The welcome renders from config/ui_help.json in auto mode, checks the Code sheet before the full read, and reports three load phases. Issue I-164 (W3) is resolved; harness Tier 7 and check 51 pass for MDL.

integration_points: Browser localStorage for theme, layout and filter preferences

core_entities: Planned document — one active row in the Master Document List register.
Code sheet — the workbook sheet that defines metadata, field columns, lookups and validation rules.
Validation issue — one finding with a rule code, severity, message and optional document reference.
Submission status — the actual first issue and review status of a document.
Approval status — the approval outcome code, which is a separate dimension from submission status.
Welcome slot — the one file entry that the MDL welcome accepts in auto mode.
relationships: One Code sheet defines the contract for the whole workbook.
Each planned document belongs to one discipline and one stage.
The Code-sheet Dashboard Title identifies the required workbook; the file name is not used.
Validation issues cite a document and a field, or describe an aggregate condition.
The welcome inspect step checks the Code sheet before buildModel reads the full workbook.
terminology: Code sheet — the contract sheet inside the workbook.
Dashboard Title — the Code-sheet value that identifies the workbook type.
W-FORMULA — one fatal warning for each column with spreadsheet formula errors.
auto mode — one required file; load starts after the Code-sheet check.

workflows.name: Build the standalone dashboard
workflows.description: Inline common welcome CSS and JS, the MDL modules and the UI help config into MDL-Dashboard.html.
steps: Inline CommonWelcome 1.4.1 and write the common-version meta tag.
Parse the bundle and write MDL-Dashboard.html.

workflows.name: Load a workbook
workflows.description: Render the welcome, check the Code sheet, report load phases and paint the dashboard.
steps: Call CommonWelcome.render with the config and handlers.
Read the Code sheet and match the expected Dashboard Title.
Report Reading, Checking and Building phases.
Build the model and call renderDashboard on the next task.

workflows.name: Verify layout conformance
workflows.description: Run the shared harness tiers for MDL, including Tier 7 welcome and check 51.
steps: Run Tier 1 structural checks and the common-version check.
Load the workbook for Tier 3 data checks.
Compare FAIL lines with the W2 baseline.

data_flows: Workbook file -> CommonWelcome.inspect -> readXlsx -> parseCodeSheet -> Dashboard Title check
Checked workbook -> buildModel -> model with records, issues, lookups and charts
model and filter state -> deriveView -> panels, KPIs, tables and exports
config/ui_help.json -> build.mjs -> WELCOME_CONFIG in the standalone HTML
common/welcome -> build.mjs -> inlined CSS and JS in the standalone HTML
data_quality_checks: V-01 … V-28 validation rules from the Code sheet
One fatal W-FORMULA warning per column with spreadsheet formula errors
Blank and formula-error tokens normalized to undefined
Code-sheet Dashboard Title check before the full workbook read

infrastructure: Playwright Chromium for harness-layout browser tiers

known_issues.title: Formula cells are read from the cache only
known_issues.details: src/xlsx-reader.mjs parses cached values and ignores formulas. 136 Submission Status cells have an empty cache. Owner decision is needed: evaluate formulas or keep the cache and warn.

known_issues.title: Submission Status and Approval Status are independent dimensions
known_issues.details: approvalCategory unifies SUR and approval codes. Owner confirmation is needed before the classifier changes.

known_issues.title: Remaining rev 1.96 dashboard gaps
known_issues.details: Two-panel Validation, pagination above 200 rows, chart hover windows, table crosshair states and a full token inventory. See MDL/log/issue_log.md.

known_issues.title: Drop-area role and duplicate tab stop
known_issues.details: The shared welcome drop area is a focusable div with no role. Review the ARIA name and the duplicate keyboard stop before PPP W4. A change needs spec §3.7 and harness assertion 45.
